comment: Ratchet floors, seeded on 2026-10-27 from the first measurement of data/gold/. Each entry sits 0.02 under what was measured, so an improvement passes and a regression stops the build. Raise a floor only in the commit that explains why; never lower one to make a red run green (AGENT_CONTRACT C2.4). The numbers these floors came from live in data/gold/results.json and are published in docs/02 2.6 and docs/05 5.1.
known_gaps: employer/title on an employer-first role line ('Acme - Senior Engineer') come out swapped: cv-21. The rule assumes title-first and cannot tell which convention a document uses from one line.
a role line whose date sits on the following line is not recognised at all: cv-22.
skills expressed as a two-column table yield one compound value per row: cv-23.
'* git and docker' is one list item carrying two skills: cv-13. Splitting ' and ' in prose has a false-positive cost no fixture yet justifies.
both the heading and the cue vocabulary are English, so a non-English advertisement yields no requirements at all: jd-06.
the corpus is author-written by the same session that wrote the rules; these numbers describe this 24-document corpus and nothing else.
